item.title: Russia’s redesigned Geran-5 missile expands threat to Ukrainian skies
item.dc:creator: John Hardie
item.description:
Ukrainian intelligence has detailed a redesigned version of Russia’s Geran-5 cruise missile, which is part of Moscow’s effort to counter Ukrainian defensive adaptation and intensify its assault on civilian infrastructure.

The post Russia’s redesigned Geran-5 missile expands threat to Ukrainian skies appeared first on FDD's Long War Journal.

item.title: Syria denies it has troops in Yemen in wake of military agreement with Saudi Arabia
item.dc:creator: Seth Frantzman
item.description:
Syrian Foreign Minister Asaad Hassan al Shaibani denied reports that Syria had deployed troops to Yemen or planned to do so, clarifying that its military agreement with Saudi Arabia focuses on rebuilding Syria’s armed forces. The statement comes amid broader diplomatic efforts by Damascus to strengthen security and political ties with Saudi Arabia, Jordan, and Iraq.

The post Syria denies it has troops in Yemen in wake of military agreement with Saudi Arabia appeared first on FDD's Long War Journal.

item.title: 8 Islamic State suspects arrested or indicted across 5 countries since October
item.dc:creator: Will Selber
item.description:
Between October 9 and November 10, authorities in five countries announced the arrests or indictments of eight individuals in Islamic State-related cases. The incidents highlight the terrorist group's continued ability to radicalize and recruit supporters online despite the loss of its territorial caliphate.

The post 8 Islamic State suspects arrested or indicted across 5 countries since October appeared first on FDD's Long War Journal.
